priors: Original bsts component and observation defaults, based only on each training series; empirical scale priors, not fully prior-independent Bayes.
point_forecast: Mean of posterior predictive distribution, then clip at zero in Python
diagnostics: rank-normalized split Rhat, bulk/tail ESS for sampled SDs and final level/slope; target Rhat<=1.01 and ESS>=400
covariates: None in M4. No fabricated regression predictors; spike-and-slab regression inapplicable.
